erbil-airport.title: Erbil International Airport Fuel Farm Rehabilitation
erbil-airport.client: Mach Monument Aviation Fueling Co Ltd
erbil-airport.smallDescription: Engineering and Procurement of E&I Works for airport fuel infrastructure.
erbil-airport.description:
Erbil International Airport (EIA) has extended the concession agreement with Mach Monument Aviation Fueling Company (MMAFCO). MMAFCO must rehabilitate the Storage Tanks, re-design and re-build all other Facilities, build additional Facilities, testing and commissioning and recertify the new fuel farm facilities, owned by EIA, and built in 2007, but was never commissioned post construction. As per the terms of the extended concession agreement, work plan for the rehabilitation and commissioning works shall be submitted to EIA and the full refurbishment of the New Fuel Farm shall be completed and commissioned in 2 years.
Karya Engineering participated as the E&I subcontractor, performing Electrical and Instrumentation engineering and procurement works.

About.title: SINCE
About.description: Karya Engineering was established in 2002. Since its foundation, the company has been providing engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning services in the Electrical and Instrumentation field. Karya Engineering specializes in electrical and instrumentation projects for petroleum, gas, and petrochemical facilities, as well as pipelines, land and marine terminals, tank farms, oil refineries, pumping stations, and power plants. The company operates primarily in the Middle East region, particularly in Northern Iraq. Its headquarters are located in İzmir, Turkey, and since 2015, it has also been serving through its branch office in Erbil, Iraq. Our activities are carried out in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System and ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System. With our experienced team that has been part of our organization for many years, we aim to continue delivering successful projects in the industry we have specialized in.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect personal information necessary to facilitate our engineering services and client communication. This includes direct identifiers such as your name, email address, phone number, company affiliation, and project-specific documentation you provide. Additionally, when you visit our website, we may automatically collect technical data, including your IP address, browser type, and operating system, to ensure site compatibility and security.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: The information we collect is primarily used to execute engineering projects, manage client accounts, and process transactions. We also use this data to respond to technical inquiries, send administrative notifications, and improve our service offerings. With your consent, we may occasionally send updates regarding new technologies or company news, though you may opt out of these communications at any time.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement robust, industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. These include Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology for encrypted data transmission, firewalls, and strict internal access controls. We regularly review our data collection, storage, and processing practices to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction of your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. These include 'essential cookies' required for the site to function and 'analytical cookies' that help us understand user behavior. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent; however, some parts of our website may not function properly without them.

thirdPartySharing.title: Third-Party Sharing
thirdPartySharing.content: We strictly do not sell, trade, or rent your personally identifiable information to others. We may share data with trusted third-party service providers (such as hosting providers or payment processors) who assist us in operating our website or conducting our business, provided these parties agree to keep the information confidential and comply with relevant data protection laws.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. You may also object to the processing of your data or request data portability. To exercise these rights or if you have any questions regarding our privacy practices, please contact us directly. We are committed to responding to all legal requests within a reasonable timeframe.

Policy.title: HSE Policy
Policy.text: We implement a meticulous planning and process management policy regarding Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Operations. Given the nature of the industries in which we operate and specialize, HSE practices hold vital importance. Fully aware of this responsibility, we adopt a human-centered approach, designing our HSE operations in line with international standards, continuously monitoring all processes, and improving them based on the most up to-date methodologies.

Process.title: HSE Process
Process.text: Our HSE process is structured around key focus areas that ensure comprehensive management of workplace safety, environmental protection, training and awareness, and risk management. By systematically addressing these areas, we create a safer working environment and promote a culture of safety across all project activities.

Points.0: Identification of task-specific hazards and risk levels
Points.1: Definition of control measures and mitigation actions
Points.2: Determining tasks of each personnel relevant to potential risks

Points.0: Daily briefings on task-related safety topics
Points.1: Reinforcement of safe work practices and procedures
Points.2: Confirmation of workforce understanding and engagement

FieldInspection.title: Regular Field Inspection from HSE Team

Points.0: Routine monitoring of site safety conditions
Points.1: Verification of compliance with HSE procedures
Points.2: Immediate reporting of unsafe acts or conditions

Points.0: Structured documentation of incidents and observations
Points.1: Root cause analysis and event classification
Points.2: Sharing lessons learned across project teams

Points.0: Development of action plans to address findings

Culture.title: A Culture of Safety
Culture.subtitleOne: Technical Training for Enhancing Job Safety
Culture.textOne: In addition to formal HSE training, we provide task-specific technical training that addresses the operational and equipment-related aspects of each role. By focusing on the technical details of the work performed, these programs enhance hazard awareness and safe execution beyond general safety instruction. This layered approach strengthens competency, reduces risk, and contributes to safer job performance across all activities.
Culture.textTwo: Our Safety Observation Card System encourages the proactive identification and reporting of unsafe acts, conditions, and positive safety behaviors. The system enables not only HSE specialists but all employees to actively contribute to the HSE process, strengthening engagement across the workforce. This structured approach supports early intervention, continuous improvement, and a safer working environment.

FocusAreaOne.title: Workplace Safety
FocusAreaOne.text: We maintain safe working conditions by systematically identifying hazards, implementing control measures, and ensuring adherence to approved procedures. Continuous supervision and workforce engagement help reduce risks and prevent incidents across all project activities.

FocusAreaTwo.title: Environmental Protection
FocusAreaTwo.text: We are committed to minimizing environmental impact through responsible resource use, waste management, and compliance with applicable environmental regulations. Our practices aim to protect surrounding ecosystems while supporting sustainable project execution.

FocusAreaThree.title: Training and Awareness
FocusAreaThree.text: We promote a strong safety culture through ongoing training programs and awareness initiatives aligned to site-specific risks. By improving workforce competency and accountability, we ensure safe practices are consistently applied in daily operations.

FocusAreaFour.title: Risk Management
FocusAreaFour.text: We proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks through structured evaluation processes and continuous monitoring. This approach supports safer decision-making and ensures stable, uninterrupted project execution.

Environmental.title: Environmental Impact
Environmental.description:
At Karya Engineering, we recognize that protecting the environment is not only a responsibility but a long-term commitment to future generations. We strive to minimize our ecological footprint by promoting sustainable work practices, efficient resource management, and strict waste control across all project phases. Environmental considerations are systematically integrated into our planning, engineering, procurement, and site execution activities to ensure full compliance with applicable regulations and internationally recognized standards.
We continuously assess our operations to identify opportunities for reducing emissions, optimizing energy consumption, preventing pollution, and improving resource efficiency. Through structured monitoring, reporting, and performance evaluation, we maintain transparency and accountability in our environmental management practices. In parallel, we promote environmental awareness among our workforce, encouraging responsible behavior and active participation in sustainability initiatives.
Our objective is to ensure that every project we undertake contributes not only to industrial progress but also to a greener, safer, and more sustainable future for the communities and environments in which we operate.

Policy.title: Quality Policy
Policy.text: Field quality control procedures form a fundamental part of our operations and are embedded in every phase of project execution. In line with the demands of our industry, we adhere strictly to internationally recognized quality standards across all activities, ensuring consistency, traceability, and technical reliability. To achieve full compliance with project specifications and client-specific quality systems, our procedures are systematically aligned with the unique requirements of each project. Through continuous monitoring, documentation, and verification processes, we maintain high levels of performance and reinforce our commitment to delivering dependable, high-quality outcomes.
